definitions.explanation: The act of firing a gun at a target, or the gunfire itself. Used both as a noun and as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: {銃撃|じゅうげき}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逃走|とうそう}→逃走：14403_tousou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{銃撃|じゅうげき}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect was shot at by police while fleeing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{銃撃|じゅうげき}{音|おん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Residents reported hearing gunfire in the residential area late at night.

notes:
A news vocabulary word frequently encountered in media reports about crime, conflict, and military operations. Composed of ⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧ (gun) + {撃|げき} (strike/attack).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銃撃|じゅうげき}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: shooting incident
- {銃撃|じゅうげき}{音|おん}: sound of gunfire
- {銃撃|じゅうげき}{戦|せん}: gun battle; firefight
- {銃撃|じゅうげき}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be shot at
- {銃撃|じゅうげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to come under fire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発砲|はっぽう}: discharge of a firearm — focuses on the single act of firing a gun, while {銃撃|じゅうげき} can imply sustained or targeted shooting
- ⟦{射撃|しゃげき}→射撃：16089_shageki⟧: shooting (as a skill or sport) — often used for target practice and marksmanship, while {銃撃|じゅうげき} implies shooting at people or in a conflict
- ⟦{狙撃|そげき}→狙撃：17429_sogeki⟧: sniping — specifically refers to shooting from a concealed position at a distance
